title: 第42章 大结局下
slug: 酒店亲错人京圈大佬他白天嫌弃晚上疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

傅临渊合上琴盖，转过身："我不会伤她的心。"

"那你要做什么？"

"娶她。"

秦妈妈愣住了。

温以染加班到八点才下班。

她骑着二手电动车，沿着新南河慢慢往福利院晃。秋夜的凉风灌进衣领，她缩了缩脖子，把车速放慢。

远远地，她看到福利院门口停着一辆黑色迈巴赫。

她的心猛地一跳，随即自嘲地笑了。

怎么可能。傅临渊那种人，怎么会来这种地方。

她停好车，推开院门，然后僵在原地。

傅临渊站在那架旧钢琴旁边，穿着一件深灰色大衣，衬得身形修长。他听到动静，转过身，目光越过夜色，直直地看进她眼里。

"温以染。"他叫她的名字，声音低沉如大提琴。

温以染攥紧包带，指甲掐进掌心。她以为自己已经忘了他的声音，忘了他的样子，忘了他的一切。

可他只是站在那里，她就溃不成军。

"傅先生，"她扬起假笑，声音甜腻，"什么风把您吹到这种小地方来了？"

傅临渊看着她。

她瘦了，脸颊凹陷下去，眼底有淡淡的青黑，嘴角扬起的弧度熟悉而陌生——那是她面对金主时的标准表情。

心脏像是被人狠狠攥了一把。

"我来找你。"他说。

"找我？"温以染笑得更大声，"傅先生要结婚了，还找我干什么？难道是婚前最后的狂欢？"

傅临渊没说话，从大衣口袋里掏出一样东西，递到她面前。

温以染低头，瞳孔骤缩。

那是一张银行卡。

"五百万。"傅临渊说。

温以染的脸色瞬间惨白。

她想起茶馆里对顾沉说的话——"你一个月能给我五百万吗？能给我就甩了他，跟你。"

原来，他知道了。

他不仅知道，还亲自来羞辱她。

温以染接过银行卡，手指抖得厉害。她扬起脸，笑容灿烂："谢谢傅先生，还是您大方。不过我已经辞职了，恐怕没法'服务'您……"

"温以染。"傅临渊打断她，"这五百万，是聘礼。"

温以染愣住。

"我取消了婚礼。"傅临渊往前走了一步，近到能闻到她发间的洗发水味道，"裴听雪不会嫁给我，我也不打算娶她。"

"你……"

"我查过了，"傅临渊的声音很轻，"你名下所有存款，两万四。过去三年，你收到的每一笔钱，都汇进了福利院账户。"

温以染的脸色变了。

"你周旋于那些男人之间，不是为了买包，不是为了高消费，甚至不是为了还债。"傅临渊又往前一步，"你只是为了养这群孩子。"

"闭嘴！"温以染后退，声音发颤，"你懂什么？你这种含着金汤匙出生的人，你懂什么！"

"我懂。"傅临渊抓住她的手腕，"我懂你没有选择。我懂你不敢爱。我懂你每次伸手要钱的时候，心里都在骂自己贱。"

温以染的眼眶红了。

"但我更懂，"傅临渊低下头，额头抵住她的额头，"你在我身下的时候，不是演的。你为我做蛋糕的时候，不是演的。你跳进河里救那个孩子的时候，不是演的。"

"温以染，你骗得了所有人，骗不了我。"

温以染的眼泪终于掉下来。

她想要挣脱，却被他抱得更紧。他的手臂还缠着绷带，力道却大得不容抗拒。

Fu Linyuan closed the piano cover and turned around: "I won't break her heart."

"Then what are you going to do?"

"Marry her."

Mother Qin was stunned.

Wen Yiran worked overtime until eight o'clock before getting off work.

She rode a second-hand electric scooter and walked slowly along the Xinnan River to the orphanage.The cool breeze of the autumn night flowed into her collar, and she shrank her neck and slowed down the car.

From a distance, she saw a black Maybach parked at the entrance of the orphanage.

Her heart skipped a beat, and then she laughed to herself.

How is it possible.How could someone like Fu Linyuan come to a place like this?

She parked the car, pushed open the courtyard door, and froze in place.

Fu Linyuan stood next to the old piano, wearing a dark gray coat that made his figure slim.When he heard the noise, he turned around and looked straight into her eyes across the night.

"Wen Yiran." He called her name, his voice as low as a cello.

Wen Yiran tightened his grip on the bag strap and dug his nails into his palms.She thought she had forgotten his voice, his appearance, everything about him.

But he just stood there, and she was defeated.

"Mr. Fu," she said with a fake smile and a sweet voice, "what brought you to such a small place?"

Fu Linyuan looked at her.

She lost weight, her cheeks were sunken, there was a faint greenish black under her eyes, and the curve at the corner of her mouth was familiar but unfamiliar - that was her standard expression when facing her financial sponsor.

My heart felt like it had been squeezed hard.

"I'm coming to find you," he said.

"Looking for me?" Wen Yiran laughed louder, "Mr. Fu is getting married, why are you looking for me? Is this the last carnival before the wedding?"

Fu Linyuan didn't say anything, but took something out of his coat pocket and handed it to her.

Wen Yiran lowered his head and his pupils suddenly shrank.

That's a bank card.

"Five million." Fu Linyuan said.

Wen Yiran's face turned pale instantly.

She remembered what she said to Gu Chen in the teahouse - "Can you give me five million a month? If you can, I'll dump him and follow you."

It turned out that he knew.

Not only did he know about it, he also came to humiliate her personally.

Wen Yiran took the bank card, his fingers shaking violently.She raised her face with a bright smile: "Thank you, Mr. Fu, for your generosity. But I have resigned and I'm afraid I won't be able to 'serve' you..."

"Wen Yiran." Fu Linyuan interrupted her, "These five million are the betrothal gift."

Wen Yiran was stunned.

"I canceled the wedding." Fu Linyuan took a step forward, close enough to smell the shampoo in her hair, "Pei Tingxue will not marry me, and I don't plan to marry her."

"You..."

"I checked," Fu Linyuan's voice was very soft, "all the deposits in your name are 24,000. In the past three years, every money you received was remitted to the welfare home account."

Wen Yiran's expression changed.

"You deal with those men, not to buy bags, not to spend money, or even to pay off debts." Fu Linyuan took another step forward, "You are just to raise these children."

"Shut up!" Wen Yiran backed away, his voice trembling, "What do you know? A person like you who was born with a silver spoon in your mouth, what do you know!"

"I understand." Fu Linyuan grabbed her wrist, "I understand you have no choice. I understand you dare not love. I understand that every time you reach out for money, you are calling yourself cheap in your heart."

Wen Yiran's eyes turned red.

"But I know better." Fu Linyuan lowered his head and pressed his forehead against hers. "When you were under me, you were not acting. When you made the cake for me, you were not acting. When you jumped into the river to save the child, you were not acting."

"Wen Yiran, you can fool everyone, but you can't fool me."

Wen Yiran's tears finally fell.

She wanted to break away, but he held her tighter.His arm was still bandaged, but the force was too strong to resist.
